files.README.md:
# kotlin-sql-sqlite-no-interfaces-services-tests

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories with their own SQL over a JDBC `Connection` and services, in Kotlin on the JVM. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: sqlite.
- Entities: written for every table.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take a Patch per field: absent, or a value that may be null.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/main/kotlin/app/AppDatabase.kt      the JDBC connection to DATABASE_URL
src/main/kotlin/app/Sql.kt              how the repositories run SQL: values and refusals
src/main/kotlin/app/UnitOfWork.kt       the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/main/kotlin/app/errors/             NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/main/kotlin/app/entities/           one entity per table
src/main/kotlin/app/repositories/       the repositories of each table
src/main/kotlin/app/services/           one service per table
src/test/kotlin/app/                    repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json                      what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
gradle test                                       # SQLite in a temporary file
TEST_DATABASE_URL="jdbc:sqlite:app.db" gradle test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

package app

import app.repositories.MemoryAuditLogRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryCategoryRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryCustomerRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryOrderLineRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryOrderRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryProductRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryProductTagRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryTagRepository
import app.repositories.SqlAuditLogRepository
import app.repositories.SqlCategoryRepository
import app.repositories.SqlCustomerRepository
import app.repositories.SqlOrderLineRepository
import app.repositories.SqlOrderRepository
import app.repositories.SqlProductRepository
import app.repositories.SqlProductTagRepository
import app.repositories.SqlTagRepository

/** The in-memory repositories, for tests and for trying the services without a database. */
class MemoryUnitOfWork : UnitOfWork {
    override val customers: SqlCustomerRepository = MemoryCustomerRepository()
    override val categories: SqlCategoryRepository = MemoryCategoryRepository()
    override val products: SqlProductRepository = MemoryProductRepository()
    override val orders: SqlOrderRepository = MemoryOrderRepository()
    override val orderLines: SqlOrderLineRepository = MemoryOrderLineRepository()
    override val tags: SqlTagRepository = MemoryTagRepository()
    override val productTags: SqlProductTagRepository = MemoryProductTagRepository()
    override val auditLog: SqlAuditLogRepository = MemoryAuditLogRepository()

    /** Memory has no transactions: changes are kept as they are made. */
    override fun <T> transaction(work: (UnitOfWork) -> T): T = work(this)
}

package app

import app.repositories.SqlAuditLogRepository
import app.repositories.SqlCategoryRepository
import app.repositories.SqlCustomerRepository
import app.repositories.SqlOrderLineRepository
import app.repositories.SqlOrderRepository
import app.repositories.SqlProductRepository
import app.repositories.SqlProductTagRepository
import app.repositories.SqlTagRepository

/** What services depend on: a repository per table and a transaction. Each service operation runs in transaction(): committed when it ends, rolled back when it throws. */
interface UnitOfWork {
    val customers: SqlCustomerRepository
    val categories: SqlCategoryRepository
    val products: SqlProductRepository
    val orders: SqlOrderRepository
    val orderLines: SqlOrderLineRepository
    val tags: SqlTagRepository
    val productTags: SqlProductTagRepository
    val auditLog: SqlAuditLogRepository

    /** Runs work with the repositories of the transaction; commits when it ends, rolls back when it throws. */
    fun <T> transaction(work: (UnitOfWork) -> T): T
}

package app

import java.io.File

/** The test database: TEST_DATABASE_URL, or SQLite in a temporary file, created from the schema before every test. */
object TestDatabase {
    /** Removes every table, so the database starts empty. */
    private val DROP = listOf(
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "audit_log"",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "product_tags"",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "tags"",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "order_lines"",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "orders"",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "products"",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "categories"",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "customers"",
    )

    /** Creates every table, in an order the database accepts. */
    private val CREATE = listOf(
        "CREATE TABLE "customers" (
  "id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "email" VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT "uq_customers_email" UNIQUE ("email")
)",
        "CREATE TABLE "categories" (
  "id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "name" VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE ("name")
)",
        "CREATE TABLE "products" (
  "id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "name" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  "price" DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  "status" VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "deleted_at" DATETIME,
  CHECK ("price" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "fk_products_category" FOREIGN KEY ("category_id") REFERENCES "categories" ("id")
)",
        "CREATE INDEX "ix_products_status" ON "products" ("status")",
        "CREATE INDEX "ix_products_category_id" ON "products" ("category_id")",
        "CREATE TABLE "orders" (
  "id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "placed_at" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY ("customer_id") REFERENCES "customers" ("id")
)",
        "CREATE TABLE "order_lines" (
  "order_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "line" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("order_id", "line"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("order_id") REFERENCES "orders" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY ("product_id") REFERENCES "products" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT
)",
        "CREATE TABLE "tags" (
  "id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "label" VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL
)",
        "CREATE TABLE "product_tags" (
  "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "tag_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("product_id") REFERENCES "products" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY ("tag_id") REFERENCES "tags" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)",
        "CREATE TABLE "audit_log" (
  "at" DATETIME NOT NULL,
  "message" TEXT NOT NULL
)",
    )

    /** The repositories over the test database, with every table dropped and created again. */
    fun open(): SqlUnitOfWork {
        val url = System.getenv("TEST_DATABASE_URL")
            ?: "jdbc:sqlite:${File.createTempFile("test", ".db").also { it.deleteOnExit() }.absolutePath}"
        val user = System.getenv("TEST_DATABASE_USER") ?: ""
        val connection = AppDatabase.connect(url, user, System.getenv("TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD") ?: "")
        connection.createStatement().use { statement -> (DROP + CREATE).forEach { statement.execute(it) } }
        return SqlUnitOfWork(connection)
    }
}
